title: Home guide: the drying paste (a model of clay)
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Making materials (9E); conservation of energy
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 18 (Home practical guide and safety card: drying paste (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Model why clay must be fired to make a ceramic.
equipment: A spoonful of soil or flour mixed with water
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Put a spoonful of paste on each saucer.
Add a little water to one dried patch. What happens?
Link it to clay: dried clay softens with water; fired clay (a ceramic) does not.
